# lightGallery

This directory vendors lightGallery 2.9.0 from the npm package `lightgallery`.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lightgallery/v/2.9.0

License: GPLv3, as declared by the package metadata. The published npm package did not include a standalone license file, so `LICENSE` contains the GNU GPLv3 license text for this vendored copy.

Vendored files:
- `lightgallery.es5.min.js` is copied from the package browser-global build `lightgallery.min.js`.
- `lightgallery.css` and `lightgallery.css.map` are copied from `css/`, with CSS asset URLs adjusted for this flattened vendor directory.
- `fonts/` and `images/loading.gif` are copied from the package assets referenced by the stylesheet.
